mapping_basis: exact AArch64 opcode/relocation parity, Docker reproducibility, KCFI, Joern scope/slice, Ghidra P-Code shape and direct ASan/UBSan contract evidence
mapping_note: Assembly and P-Code preserve the 18-entry event dispatch, throttling, escalation, client-record/client-notify calls and buffer clearing. Ghidra normalized C has a recorded external-label decompiler artifact; it is accepted only with exact P-Code shape and independent relocation-aware assembly parity.
limitations: The package promotes only an offline static equivalence state.
The Docker/harness environment stubs zlog transport and kernel services.
Hardware, Android scheduler, IRQ, SPI and touch controller remain unverified.
